gaps.message: AC-1.5 says a rule violation returns HTTP 422, and that rule list includes unique name. TEST_SPEC case FR-01 #14 asserts 409 for a duplicate name, following SRS.md:320 and NFR-99.3. The choice is recorded in the header and on the row, but the SPEC owner still has to confirm it.

NFR-99.2 leaves the injection blacklist character set unspecified. Cases FR-01 #13 and #15 and FR-02 #10 assume ';' is blacklisted and '$' is accepted, and each row records that as a precondition. These assumptions need confirmation from the SPEC owner.

The Deferred row for NFR-06 (test_nfr06_sqlalchemy_forbidden_outside_repository) uses forbidden_source_modules="4" (api, service, config, errors). SRS AC-N6.2 says any layer other than repository, a wider reading that matches the open point in ADR-002. This is the same unresolved question carried over from the ADR review.

The Summary reports 2 smoke cases, but the Deployment Smoke table lists only one row. The second smoke case is presumably in another section. The totals are consistent, but the smoke attribution is not obvious.

The consistency gate flags 224 predicates as needing Agent B review because they reference production outputs outside its recognised length/count patterns. These are advisory notes only and the gate result is OK.
